annotation.title_clean: Declaration of Montevideo: For the construction of a regional approach on the governance of Artificial Intelligence and its impacts on our society
annotation.title_en: Declaration of Montevideo: For the construction of a regional approach on the governance of Artificial Intelligence and its impacts on our society
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministers and High-Level Authorities, Second Ministerial Summit on the Ethics of AI in Latin America and the Caribbean (Uruguay, with UNESCO and CAF)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ministerial declaration from the second Latin America and Caribbean summit on AI ethics (Montevideo, Oct 2024). It approves a regional Roadmap with five priority areas, consolidates a permanent Working Group, and makes the summit annual, supported by UNESCO and CAF, in line with the UNESCO Recommendation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves a regional AI ethics Roadmap with prioritized areas
Priority areas: governance and regulation; talent and future of work; vulnerable groups; environment and climate; infrastructure
Consolidates the Working Group on AI Ethics in LAC as a permanent dialogue space
Makes the ministerial summit an annual meeting
UNESCO and CAF to act as technical secretary; Uruguay continues leading the Working Group
